\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{listings,xcolor}
\newsavebox\lstbox
% Displayed listings in boxes in a paragraph (text.boxed_listings): a
% line wider than a phone's column, captions at the bottom, and two
% listings in one box.
\begin{document}
\section{Boxed listings}
\begin{lrbox}{\lstbox}\begin{lstlisting}
wide(); /* a line wider than the column of a phone screen */
\end{lstlisting}\end{lrbox}
Wide \fbox{\usebox{\lstbox}} then $a$.

\begin{lrbox}{\lstbox}\begin{lstlisting}[caption={Below env},captionpos=b]
bottomenv();
\end{lstlisting}\end{lrbox}
Bottom \fbox{\usebox{\lstbox}} then $b$.

\begin{lrbox}{\lstbox}\begin{lstlisting}
twoA();
\end{lstlisting}\begin{lstlisting}[caption={Above second}]
twoB();
\end{lstlisting}\end{lrbox}
Two \fbox{\usebox{\lstbox}} then $c$.

\begin{lrbox}{\lstbox}\begin{lstlisting}[caption={Below first},captionpos=b]
pairA();
\end{lstlisting}\begin{lstlisting}[caption={Above next}]
pairB();
\end{lstlisting}\end{lrbox}
Pair \fbox{\usebox{\lstbox}} then $d$.

% (a title, with no number and no anchor before it)
\begin{lrbox}{\lstbox}\begin{lstlisting}
titleA();
\end{lstlisting}\begin{lstlisting}[title={Titled next}]
titleB();
\end{lstlisting}\end{lrbox}
Titled \fbox{\usebox{\lstbox}} then $e$.

% (frame=shadowbox with a black rulesepcolor: a shadow in the text's
% color, also in dark mode)
\begin{lstlisting}[frame=shadowbox,rulesepcolor=\color{black}]
blackshadow();
\end{lstlisting}

\end{document}
